approvalRef: Organization supplement development procedure — model eligibility punctuation
description: Model eligibility column must not contain a dot unless it is part of the model number.
findingText: A Model/Series Eligibility cell contains a '.' that is not part of a model number.
resolutionHint: Remove the period from the Model/Series Eligibility cell unless it forms part of the model number itself.
